# evroc_permission_set (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc permission set.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the permission set to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether this permission set grants admin privileges.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the permission set was created (RFC3339 format).
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `permission_set_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the permission set.
- `project` (String) Project ID this permission set belongs to.
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels attached to the permission set.
